G1_oos_expectancy.definition: candidate OOS net expectancy per trade > baseline OOS net expectancy per trade

G2_survives_costs.definition: candidate advantage still > 0 on the reported cost grid (at least at the production 0.10R cost)

G3_drawdown_within_limits.definition: G3a max drawdown <= max_drawdown_pct_of_capital; G3b <= 1.5x baseline; G3c largest single loss <= max_single_loss_pct_of_capital
G3_drawdown_within_limits.ratio_limit_note: max(1.5 x baseline DD, ratio_floor_pct_of_capital x capital)

G5_no_bias.definition: unit tests + data-quality + PIT/look-ahead tests all PASS and the cost/execution model is identical

G6_robustness.definition: net expectancy positive in >= 2 of 3 periods and >= 2 of 3 walk-forward blocks per instrument; both instruments not materially negative

G7_credit_spread_economics.definition: requires real historical option premiums; BLOCKED if option history is absent
G7_credit_spread_economics.note: UNAVAILABLE -> this run is an UNDERLYING (spot) signal study only; credit-spread P&L cannot be claimed from these inputs

_final.rule: any FAIL -> FAIL; else any BLOCKED/INCONCLUSIVE -> INCONCLUSIVE; else PASS (review only, never auto-deploy)
